blocks.text: # Design together
blocks.start: Design together

blocks.text: Forma is where teams design, prototype and hand off in one place.
[Start for free](https://forma.example/signup)

blocks.text: ## How teams use it
blocks.start: How teams use it

blocks.text: A designer at a company of forty opens the file a product manager started the evening before, finds the three frames that were sketched in boxes and grey text, and replaces them with components from the team's library; by noon the engineer who will build the screen has left six comments on it, each pinned to the control it is about.
Nothing was exported and nothing was sent.
## Integrations
blocks.start: Integrations

blocks.text: Forma works with the tools a team already has.

blocks.start: Tracker: link a frame to the issue it answers.

blocks.text: - Chat: a message when someone comments on your file.
blocks.start: Chat: a message when someone comments on your file.

blocks.text: - Repository: design tokens written to a branch as JSON.
blocks.start: Repository: design tokens written to a branch as JSON.

blocks.text: - Docs: a live frame inside a page of writing.
blocks.start: Docs: a live frame inside a page of writing.

blocks.text: - Calendar: a review booked from the file it is about.

## Frequently asked questions
blocks.start: Frequently asked questions

blocks.text: ### Can I bring my files from another tool?
blocks.start: Can I bring my files from another tool?

blocks.text: Yes. Forma opens Sketch and Figma files, and keeps their components and styles.
### What happens to my files if I stop paying?
blocks.start: What happens to my files if I stop paying?

blocks.text: They stay, read-only, for as long as the account does. You can export them at any time.
### Is there a discount for schools?
blocks.start: Is there a discount for schools?

blocks.text: The Team plan is free for students and teachers.
